questions.question: The type of rivet which is used to join the two plates without the need to make a through hole in the joining plates:

explanations.b: Split rivets can be used without a full through hole.
explanations.c: Round is a head shape, not a type.

questions.question: Important feature of the rivet for which it is mostly used:
The design related cause events does not include:

answers.b: Improper selection of the type of joint

explanations.d: Proper sizing is not a cause of failure.

questions.question: The applications where strength, rigidity, as well as security against leakage should be considered:

answers.b: Boiler drums, pressure vessels, gas tanks

explanations.d: Incorrect because doors don’t need leak-proofing.

questions.question: A riveted joint may not fail during its service life by:

explanations.c: Not a typical failure mode of riveted joints.
